item.name: Public - list hides drafts and case-study text

exec: pm.test("project A listed", function () { pm.expect(j.data.map(p => p.slug)).to.include('test-map-a'); });
pm.test("no case-study fields in list", function () { pm.expect(j.data.every(p => !('problem' in p) && !('solution' in p) && !('result' in p))).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("only ev projects", function () { pm.expect(j.data.every(p => p.sector === 'ev')).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("project B present", function () { pm.expect(j.data.map(p => p.slug)).to.include('test-map-b'); });

item.name: Public - project A detail has the case study
Public - map lists both Lahore projects, no draft

exec: pm.test("A and B present", function () { pm.expect(j.data.map(p => p.slug)).to.include.members(['test-map-a','test-map-b']); });
pm.test("all have numeric coordinates", function () { pm.expect(j.data.every(p => typeof p.latitude === 'number' && typeof p.longitude === 'number')).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("same city for A and B", function () { pm.expect(j.data.filter(p => ['test-map-a','test-map-b'].includes(p.slug)).every(p => p.city === 'Lahore')).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("only drafts", function () { pm.expect(j.data.every(p => p.isPublished === false)).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("solution kept", function () { pm.expect(j.data.solution).to.eql('Test solution text.'); });
